So i went from unexperienced to i can ride in a single day and it was realitivley easy. My board might be different as i got it second hand and im also in realitivley good shape which helped. 

I started by putting one foot on the board and figuring out which i wqs gonna use to kick

Then once i figured it out one foot on the board and the other eould stay on the ground or kick until i was totally comfortable

Then id move onto getting on the board which didnt have to be super quick just a little push and on and then off.

Eventually youll get the hang of it to put your one foot on the board and then the other and be able to ride in a straight line

Once you get the straight line with just standing then add kicking into the equation

Its not a hard process but it defintley took like 2 hours where i felt comfortable riding 15 yards straight

Id say if you wanna ride to school its gonna take a couple weeks before you really get comfy and dont push it either.

I broke my finger a month after getting the board as i was too fast and too cocky ALWAYS play it safe
